meta.pageTitle: Challenger TFT Coaching — 1-on-1 Sessions Live on Discord
meta.pageDescription: Personalized 1-on-1 Teamfight Tactics coaching with a Challenger-ranked player. Live on Discord with screen share — economy, positioning, and decision-making that actually ranks you up.

hero.subline: Personalized one-on-one TFT coaching, live on Discord. We find what's actually capping your rank — then fix it, game by game.

credentials.title: Proof over promises.
credentials.lede: Anyone can claim a rank. Mine is public — go check the ladder yourself.
credentials.verifyButton: See my live ladder profile on MetaTFT

offerings.title: Sessions & plans
offerings.lede: One session or a full training arc — every offer runs live on Discord, and bundle plans save you money.

singleSessions.title: 1-Hour Session
singleSessions.description: VOD review of your recent lobbies over Discord screen share — or live-game coaching, your pick.

singleSessions.title: 2-Hour Deep Dive
singleSessions.description: VOD review to pin down your biggest leaks, then a live game where I coach your calls in real time — plus a post-game recap.

trainingPlans.title: Starter Plan
trainingPlans.description: Lock in the fundamentals — economy, tempo, stage-by-stage decision-making — with a plan we adjust after every session.

trainingPlans.title: Climb Plan
trainingPlans.description: A structured multi-week program built around your ladder games — we track your leaks and close them one by one.

trainingPlans.title: Pro Plan
trainingPlans.description: The full grind to Master+ — a long-term roadmap, priority scheduling, and a coach who knows your game inside out.

offerings.customText: Tell me what you have in mind — hours, format, budget. I'll make it work.
offerings.customMailLink: Or e-mail me your offer directly

curriculum.title: What you'll learn
curriculum.lede: No cookie-cutter lectures. We work on the four levers that decide every lobby.

cards.title: Economy & Tempo
cards.text: Master the gold curve — when to greed, when to roll, and when tempo alone wins the lobby.

cards.title: Scouting & Positioning
cards.text: Scout every board in seconds and position like you've already seen the fight play out.

cards.title: Meta & Comp Flexibility
cards.text: Play what your shops and items give you — not one forced comp off a tier list.

cards.title: Stage-by-Stage Decision-Making
cards.text: Turn chaotic mid-game spots into routine calls with a clear checklist for every stage.

testimonialsSection.title: Student results
testimonialsSection.lede: Ranks are the receipts. Here's where past students started — and where they ended up.

how.title: How it works
how.lede: Three steps between you and your first session.

steps.title: Send a request
steps.text: Fill out the form below with your rank and your goals. I read every request personally.

steps.title: We schedule
steps.text: I reply within 24 hours via email or Discord and we lock a time — you'll already know the price from the offer you picked.

steps.title: We go live
steps.text: One-on-one on Discord with screen share: live games, review, and a concrete plan to keep climbing.

how.note: Every price is listed under Offerings — pick a single session, or save with a training plan.

contactSection.title: Tell me where you're stuck.
contactSection.lede: The more specific you are about your goals, the better the first session gets.
contactSection.labelMessage: What do you want to work on?
contactSection.messagePlaceholder: Where are you stuck, and what's your goal for this set? e.g. 'Hardstuck Emerald 2 — I bleed out in stage 4 and never stabilize.'
contactSection.successTitle: Request sent — I'll get back to you within 24 hours.
contactSection.successText: I'll reach out by email — or on Discord, if you left your handle.
